Presented by . Africa is a place where we can still discover new things about nature—including how humans can live in harmony with the animals who share our world.
Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in Africa Earth’s Wild Home.
